test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The ______ for a vaccine could take up to a year.
solution: The correct answer is '**search**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**search**'. • In the given sentence '**search for**' is **a phrasal verb.** • It means **'to examine somebody/something carefully because you are looking for something; to look for something that is missing'.** (अभीष्‍ट वस्‍तु की खोज में किसी की बारीकी से जाँच करना; खोई हुई वस्‍तु को तलाशना) • *Example: The men were arrested and **searched for** drugs.* **Correct Sentence:__** *The **search **for a vaccine could take up to a year.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Chase**: to run after somebody/something in order to catch him/her/it. (पकड़ने के लिए किसी के पीछे-पीछे भागना; किसी का पीछा करना) • **Pursuit**: the action of trying to achieve or get something. (कुछ पाने की कोशिश) • **Track**: a natural path or rough road. (लोगों के चलने से बना रास्‍ता, पगडंडी या ऊबड़-खाबड़ सड़क) 3e:Td3f, The correct answer is '**recover**'.
